notes.title: Graphics update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44892313/b271526aad7d9d4951d9255623b161a6e6826950.jpg[/img]

Hello, everyone. 
Today we've added a version of the game with new graphics, namely a completely redesigned environment for the first four levels.

notes.title: The game is already available in early access
notes.content:
I ask everyone to try the game in early access, and I also remind you that I will be looking forward to hearing suggestions for improving the game and further development in the discussions
